settings.heading: Made in Yorkshire, named for the fells next door.

settings.text: Is the slower first step stiffness, or something that needs looking at?
Would a lower step-in or a firmer surface help them get up?
Is their weight where it should be? Extra kilos make every rise harder.

settings.title: It arrives
settings.text: Put it where they already sleep, with a blanket that smells of home on top.

settings.title: Give them time
settings.text: Plenty of dogs claim a new bed the first evening. Some take a fortnight. Both are normal, and you've got [nights].

settings.title: Not right? Tell us
settings.text: Any time inside the [nights] nights. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund every penny.
